findings.text: the fragment quotes the refusal as 'absent on this node and not the task's temp directory', which reckon/nested_launch.py:752 does not emit, so a reader matching the evidence document to the code finds no such message.

the negative-control bullet says the test that starts a sandboxed command reddens, while negative-control.log shows test_a_temp_directory_the_job_node_cannot_supply_is_named failing on returncode 1 against FENCE_SOURCE_STATUS 126 and test_the_tasks_own_temp_directory_stands_in_and_the_task_runs passing; tests/test_a_gate_run_starts_inside_the_sandbox.py:48-53 repeats the same misnaming.

the absent-source scan's option tuple omits --ro-bind and --ro-bind-try although :732 claims every mounted source is checked, and treats --bind-try/--dev-bind-try as fatal though bubblewrap reads them as optional, so a ro-bound source still falls through to bubblewrap's node-less message and a later try-flagged grant would be refused before start.
